# Get Regular

> Get Regular is an AI gut health app for iPhone. It helps adults with bloating, constipation, diarrhea or IBS-type symptoms see what drives their digestion by tracking stool (Bristol Stool Scale, by photo or manual entry), meals and symptoms together, then showing patterns over time. It is a wellness tracker, not a diagnostic tool. Made by Get Regular Health, Inc. (US).

## Facts
- Name: Get Regular (App Store title: "Get Regular: AI Gut Health")
- Company: Get Regular Health, Inc.
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). Not available on Android or web.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6749188690
- Category: Health & Fitness
- Price: free download; premium features need a subscription. US App Store prices as listed on 2 Nov 2026: $12.99/month, $99.99/year, Founding Yearly $79.99.
- Clinical advisor: Michael Schopis, MD (see the clinical review page for what that role covers)
- Contact: hello@getregular.com

## Who it is for
- Adults with bloating, constipation, diarrhea or IBS-type symptoms
- People trying to find which foods or habits affect their digestion
- People preparing for a doctor or gastroenterology appointment who want tracked data instead of memory

## What it does
- Stool tracking on the Bristol Stool Scale (types 1-7), from a photo or by manual entry without a photo
- Meal logging by photo, with a nutrition breakdown
- Symptom tracking alongside meals and bowel movements
- Daily gut and nutrition scores and a weekly digest of patterns
- Gut Check: an AI assistant that answers questions about the user's own logged data
- Doctor Report: a summary of patterns to share with a clinician
- Apple Health integration

## What it is not
- Not a diagnostic tool and not a replacement for a doctor. Anyone with blood in the stool, black stool, unexplained weight loss or symptoms that wake them at night should see a doctor.
